scope: One bounded twelve-case synthetic regression of one statically audited map. No native result is used to choose or modify mapping thresholds.

route_planning_checks.limit: Diagnostics describe the last route attempt and can remain latched over many captures, including stopped states. Frame, value and transition counts are not independent planning attempts. This check does not infer a fresh radius from the current row covariance.
